Bug_Title: ICAST: int value cast to float and then passed to Math.round (ICAST_INT_CAST_TO_FLOAT_PASSED_TO_ROUND)
Bug_Details:
This code converts an int value to a float precision
floating point number and then
passing the result to the Math.round() function, which returns the int/long closest
to the argument. This operation should always be a no-op,
since converting an integer to a float should give a number with no fractional part.
It is likely that the operation that generated the value to be passed
to Math.round was intended to be performed using
floating point arithmetic.
Bug_Explanation: This code demonstrates an int value being cast to a float and then passed to the Math.round() function. Since casting an integer to a float should give a number with no fractional part, the operation is intended to be a no-op. However, the operation that generated the value to be passed to Math.round was likely intended to be performed using floating point arithmetic.

When a float is passed to Math.round(), in this case when an integer is cast to a float and then passed, the result is the same as the original integer. As a result, this code will always return the same integer, even though it should be returning the closest int/long to the floating point argument. This is because casting an integer to a float should give a number with no fractional part.
